item.title: Welcome!
item.author: Hafis Muhammad
item.description: Hey there! This is my first post using Hugo. Hugo is a static site generator to help you build websites easier than before. I ran this website locally and published it using Github Pages. I would like to write about the making of this blog later. Thank you.
